evaluation.justification: The summary exhibits several issues that reduce its internal coherence. There are clear instances of unnecessary repetition (S2/S3 and S10/S11) that do not add new information and weaken the flow. Sentence S6 contains redundant phrasing and awkward structure, and S13 similarly has repetitive language. While the overall structure follows a logical sequence from consolidated performance to segment details and then to investments and cash positions, these repetitions and structural issues prevent the summary from achieving full coherence. There are no self-contradictions or logical gaps, and the segment figures are presented without implying they should arithmetically sum to the consolidated total.
